snippet.title: 1001 Threads of Mizan - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
1001 Threads of Mizan is a 1-3 player co-op action adventure game set in a sprawling Arabian fantasy world.

Soar across mythic landscapes on nimble flying carpets, battle colossal jinn that tower above the world, and unravel a tale of betrayal that threatens to tear the world apart. Inspired by One Thousand and One Nights, this is a shared journey where exploration, combat, and storytelling are woven into a single, unforgettable experience.

United by the famed Storyweaver, Shahrazad, three unlikely heroes will rediscover the lost power of the Mizan, in a quest to take down an ancient jinn king, before his thirst for vengeance destroys humanity.

Visit the website to find out more
https://1001threadsofmizan.com

Connect with us
Discord - https://discord.gg/1001threadsofmizan
